description: This file defines quantizable LSTM and LSTMCell modules, including classes for single-layer and multi-layer bidirectional LSTMs, with support for decomposition into building blocks for quantization and inference optimization.

classes.name: LSTMCell
classes.description: A quantizable implementation of an LSTM cell supporting decomposition into building blocks for quantization.

classes.name: _LSTMSingleLayer
classes.description: A single unidirectional LSTM layer processing sequences step-by-step.

classes.name: _LSTMLayer
classes.description: A bidirectional or unidirectional LSTM layer composed of two _LSTMSingleLayer instances.

classes.name: LSTM
classes.description: A multi-layer, possibly bidirectional, quantizable LSTM module composed of multiple _LSTMLayer instances.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Performs the forward pass of the LSTMCell, processing input tensor and hidden states.

methods.name: initialize_hidden
methods.description: Initializes hidden and cell states, optionally quantized.

methods.name: from_params
methods.description: Creates an LSTMCell instance from given weights and biases.

methods.name: from_float
methods.description: Converts a float LSTM or LSTMCell module into its quantizable counterpart.

methods.name: from_float
methods.description: Creates an _LSTMSingleLayer from a float module.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Processes input sequence through a single unidirectional LSTM layer.

methods.name: from_float
methods.description: Creates an _LSTMLayer from a float module.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Processes input sequence through the multi-layer LSTM, handling bidirectionality and hidden states.
